checks.title: Board and Session end-to-end acceptance
checks.instructions: Start from migrated/default Board state. Create B, switch A->B->A in one Session, start a new Session on A, verify clean conversation with preserved Board/task state, switch to B, verify Board-specific mode/state restoration, and inspect alerts from background work.
checks.expected: Session and Board feel distinct: conversations reset only when requested; Board work persists; switching is context-clean; background results remain discoverable.
